detailed_descriptions_html.en:
《TEVI: Fauna Arcana》 The Adventure Continues!

After tireless investigation, Tevi have followed a crucial lead and set out once again! This time, their destination is Rabina Island — a mysterious land far beyond the borders of Az.

In "TEVI: Fauna Arcana", Tevi travels to this enigmatic island to search for a missing companion. Along the way, players will reunite with allies to confront the threats lurking on the island and gradually unveil the secrets of an ancient holy land...

《TEVI: Fauna Arcana》 Vena Joins the Fight!

Vena has officially joined the battle! She will be fighting side-by-side with you against powerful foes—and perhaps... even joining you on the rest of your journey?!

《TEVI: Fauna Arcana》 Content Includes:

  • A brand-new story chapter featuring the original voice cast.

  • New combat skills and various equipment upgrades.

  • New, switchable outfits for the main character.

  • 5 unique and challenging boss battles.

  • New stages with featured minions and foes.

  • Friends who will stay by TEVI’s side forever ♡

  • Even more bunny ears!
